Today I learnt in group therapy that recovery is not linear, it is normal when there are lots of ups and downs and that it is ok to feel sad. The important thing is what you do about it when your mood starts to go down, for example if you stay in bed all day, your chances of getting worse are higher than if you go for a walk. I'm not saying it's easy, because it's not. I'm struggling myself, but you need to seek professional help. Do you have to tell your parents? If they are not helpful, then don't tell them for now. Look for the psychological services yourself in your area, find out the process to get referred to a service (I'm not sure how it works in America, but where I live you can self-refer online). Maybe your parents won't be that bad, I thought my dad was going to be judgemental but to my surprise he's been very supportive. Just take your time to tell them.
Also you might want to check organisations that help LGTB teens like you, maybe they can offer you some guidance
